briefing: - 两漏洞均无在野利用与勒索标记，暂不按已遭利用响应。
- CVE-2026-120189 评分10.0，网络设备栈溢出，须最优先处置。
- Apache反序列化RCE达9.8，版本待补，先隔离暴露面并核查。
- 今日仅2条高危公告，非批量趋势；关注设备与Apache后续补丁。

items.title: D-Link DIR-505 TFTP栈溢出
items.summary_zh: 远程攻击者可向DIR-505的TFTP上传服务提交超长文件名,触发栈溢出,可能导致设备崩溃或被控
items.action_zh: 该型号已停产无修复,建议停用TFTP功能、限制69/UDP访问并隔离设备
items.repro_note: 未认证向69/UDP的TFTP上传接口提交超长文件名参数
items.impact_scope: 停产家用路由器,多暴露于网络边缘
items.description: A vulnerability was identified in D-Link DIR-505 1.10B02. Affected is the function save_upload_file/mp_upload_file of the file /usr/bin/tftpd of the component TFTP Upload Filename Handler. The manipulation leads to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used.

items.title: Apache MINA 3.0反序列化RCE
items.summary_zh: 若应用将MINA 3.0解码器前置处理不可信流量,攻击者可投递恶意帧反序列化远程执行代码
items.affected: Apache(产品与版本待 NVD/厂商补充)
items.action_zh: 3.0分支已停维护无官方修复,须移除该解码器或改用受支持版本
items.repro_note: 需应用将JavaNativeMessageDecoder前置处理不可信帧,再投gadget链
items.impact_scope: 使用MINA 3.0的Java中间件通信组件
items.description: **UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED** JavaNativeMessageDecoder in the MINA 3.0 codec module calls ObjectInputStream.readObject() on frame bytes with no class filter, so an application that puts it in front of an untrusted peer is open to gadget-chain RCE. As the 3.0.0 branch is inactive, we do not plan to release a version that fixes this issue. Users are recommended to use the latest Apache MINA 2.2.X branch.
